intervention_matrix.baseline: unperturbed source condition and its cached global embedding
intervention_matrix.embedding_recompute: Use the frozen vision_processor, vision_encoder and vision_encoder_2 to encode original and perturbed source tensors. The global-only/joint arm is cached_baseline + (encode(perturbed) - encode(original)); this keeps the exact cached baseline while applying only the color perturbation's encoder delta. Log cache-versus-recomputed identity and the delta. This prevents any stale-cache offset from entering the causal contrast.

channel_control_rule: A channel has a repeatable directional response when its channel-only arm moves source-view mean a*/b* in the requested direction for both signs on at least 3/4 objects, and moves the mean of at least 4/5 unseen views in that direction on at least 3/4 objects; mean magnitude must exceed 1 Lab unit per 6-unit input step. Joint-arm results are a consistency check. Otherwise report control as not identified.
stop_rule: No threshold or scale search. If both channel-only arms fail the locked response rule, do not present an evidence-based repair; run the bounded C1 candidate only as a prespecified falsification check and do not proceed to a positive claim.
